title: Voice and Swallowing Outcomes Following Revision Anterior Cervical Spine Surgery
brief_summary: Evaluate voice and swallowing outcomes post operatively.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients undergoing revision anterior cervical spine surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* Primary pathology of the upper aero-digestive tract other than mild chronic pharyngitis, pre-existing vocal cord paralysis.
study_population: Patients undergoing revision anterior cervical spine surgery
